_comment: Workload profiles. 'sizes' is an ordered preference list, best first; the planner walks it and picks the first size that is available in the region, within quota, and inside the budget ceiling.

tiny.summary: Smoke test / connectivity check. Cheapest thing that boots.

render.summary: Video encode and compositing (ffmpeg, Pillow, numpy). CPU-bound and parallel — compute-optimised cores win.

render-lite.summary: Shorter renders and single-clip encodes. Half the cores, half the burn rate.

audio.summary: TTS, mixing and loudness normalisation. Memory matters more than core count.

batch.summary: General parallel batch work — transcode sweeps, file processing, long builds.
